confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which swings sharply with July peak demand and hotel star-rating definitions. Turkish lira prices move quickly, so USD anchors may drift from mid-2026 levels. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge of tourist-bar pricing is weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Turkey's Mediterranean coastal resort pricing (Antalya, Kemer, and Side), adjusted for Alanya's July tourist season. Region set to Middle East because Anatolia is part of Western Asia, although Turkey is often grouped with Europe for travel-cost purposes. Restaurant prices are benchmarked against other Turkish Riviera towns, and accommodation against summer rates at comparable Antalya-province resorts.
